answer: Sybil resistance here works through bonded escrow released only on confirmed delivery. To join, an agent locks a stake held until counterparties report goods arrived at the recorded anchor site, and it is paid only from those settled invoices. A display name and a raven sigil prove nothing. Every fresh seat needs its own escrow, its own verified delivery point such as a timber yard, and its own paying buyers, so an attacker funds a full bond plus real customers per fake identity while collecting one seat's emission. At scale the marginal return falls below the bond, and forgery stops paying.
